name: Enhanced Equality
body:
You know the faces of the forgotten by heart.

Prerequisite(s): Equality pool class feature.

Benefit(s): The size of your equality pool increases by +1. If, when preparing your aspects for the day, the highest prominence level among your major aspects is 2 or less, you gain a temporary equality point. This temporary equality point lasts for 24 hours.
